description: This Java class 'WeightPackageSession' manages the packing process of shipments within the Ofbiz framework. It handles creation and manipulation of package lines, calculation of shipping costs, integration with UPS shipping services, and updates to shipment and order statuses during the packing and shipping process.

classes.name: WeightPackageSession
classes.description: Main class managing shipment package sessions, including packaging items, calculating costs, and interfacing with shipping services.

methods.name: createWeightPackageLine
methods.description: Adds a new package line with specific dimensions and shipment box type to the session.

methods.name: complete
methods.description: Finalizes the shipment by creating packages, calculating shipping costs, and updating order/shipment statuses.

methods.name: completeShipment
methods.description: Completes the shipment process, optionally calling UPS shipment accept service, and changing order status.

methods.name: getShippableWeight
methods.description: Calculates total weight of all packed items for a given order.

methods.name: setPackageWeight
methods.description: Sets the weight for a specific package line identified by seq id.

methods.name: setPackageLength
methods.description: Sets the length dimension for a specific package line identified by seq id.

methods.name: setPackageWidth
methods.description: Sets the width dimension for a specific package line identified by seq id.

methods.name: setPackageHeight
methods.description: Sets the height dimension for a specific package line identified by seq id.

methods.name: setShipmentBoxTypeId
methods.description: Sets the shipment box type ID for a specific package line.

methods.name: deletePackedLine
methods.description: Removes a specific package line by seq id from the session.

methods.name: clearPackedLines
methods.description: Clears all packaged lines associated with a specific order ID.

methods.name: getPackedLine
methods.description: Retrieves a package line by its sequence ID.

methods.name: getPackedLines
methods.description: Returns all packed lines, optionally filtered by order ID.

methods.name: setDimensionAndShipmentBoxType
methods.description: Resets dimension and shipment box type details for a given package line.

methods.name: updateShipmentRouteSegments
methods.description: Updates billing weight and UOM for shipment route segments based on current packed items.

methods.name: setShipmentToPacked
methods.description: Changes the shipment status to 'PACKED' in the system.

methods.name: getShipmentCostEstimate
methods.description: Calculates an estimated shipping cost based on various shipment parameters.

methods.name: savePackagesInfo
methods.description: Creates packages and optionally confirms shipment with UPS if configured.

methods.name: getOrderedQuantity
methods.description: Returns total ordered item quantity for a specific order.
